question: When did the peasant movement in Bardoli begin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1928.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In India, the **Bardoli movement** was a tax-free movement.
 
• In the year **1928**__, the Bardoli Satyagraha took place.
 
• This movement was known as one of the biggest incidents of the Civil Disobedience movement, which was a part of India's war for independence.
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel **eventually headed the movement, and its success helped pave the way for Patel to become one of the most prominent leaders of the independence struggle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel initially wrote to the** Governor of Bombay**, requesting that the taxes be reduced during the year during which the tragedies were occurring.
 
• The Governor, on the other hand, ignored the letter and responded by announcing the collection.
 
• The Bombay Presidency ignored the plight of the farmers and increased tax **rates by 22%.**
 
• Patel then informed all of the farmers in the Bardoli taluka to **refuse to pay their taxes.**
 
• The government had commissioned the **Maxwell-Broomfield Commission** to investigate the situation.
 
• Following a thorough investigation, the tax increase was determined to be only **6.03%.**
 
• Gandhiji also supported the movement through his writings in the periodical '**Young India**.'
